title: One Metric, Every Angle
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: The chosen metric, year to date
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_ts <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: vs last year %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * ((SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_ts <= DATE '2026-09-30') / (SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts <= DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 1 YEAR) - 1), 2)

density.rule: a monthly line of events, company totals
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts))
